column1: # Where a function of the recreated source is in the original image, when tools/equiv_m33.py cannot take it from
# decomp/ifdsp/m33/functions.tsv by name: the Ghidra name differs, Ghidra has the name on another function, or the
# function is not in the image at all ('-'). Columns: source name, Ghidra name or 0x address or '-', evidence.
# Functions that Ghidra's list lacks are found by the tool itself (byte search, then neighbours in link order) and
# Since the re-export after T24 round 2 (449 functions) Ghidra carries the corrected names (main, __main, vsprintf,
# sprintf, the SDK 2.9 vector names, ...), so those rows are gone; left are what Ghidra's list still lacks.
